Update this file IN THE SAME COMMIT as any intentional config change; a mismatch is a deploy blocker. Born 2026-07-07 after the NIFTY-giveback wiring gap (flag enabled in .env.compose but the NIFTY compose service never passed the var â€” silent no-op for weeks).
_sensex_note: 2026-08-07 onboarding: strategy_app_sensex/execution_app_sensex/seller_app_sensex entries are deliberately NOT in `services` yet -- those containers don't exist (cold start, Phase 5/6/7 pending, see docs/ONBOARDING_INSTRUMENT.md). The checker's main loop iterates every key under `services` and tries `docker exec <key> printenv`, so adding them now would make this UNREACHABLE-fail permanently at the 09:00 IST daily run for containers that were never meant to be running. Add the 3 entries back to `services` in the SAME commit that actually starts each container, matching how FINNIFTY's entries were added at its Stage 3 paper launch, not at registry time.
_seller_note: 2026-09-08: option_trading-seller_app-1 (BankNifty) and option_trading-seller_app_nifty-1 (NIFTY) -- both real-money-capable premium sellers -- were SIGKILLed on user instruction after adverse market conditions and have not been restarted; resume is an explicit user decision, not something this repo or an operator should do by default. Moved their expect/require_nonempty blocks to stopped_services below (checker does not iterate that key, so it no longer UNREACHABLE-fails on every run) rather than deleting them, since they document the real live-money config those services ran with before the halt -- move an entry back into services in the SAME commit that actually resumes it, and re-verify the values are still correct first (this is a 2026-07 snapshot, not necessarily current).

option_trading-seller_app-1._comment: 2026-08-22: SELLER_IV_RANK_MIN lowered 30->15 for BankNifty only (BANKNIFTY_SELLER_IV_RANK_MIN override) after it sat with zero trades since 2026-07-27 at floor=30. 19-month backtest showed floor=15 is P&L-flat and tail-risk-unchanged vs floor=30, just unlocks more trading days. NIFTY/FINNIFTY/SENSEX keep the shared default of 30.

option_trading-strategy_app-1._comment: 2026-08-10: calculated-risk loosening (user decision after a 'no trades' review) -- ENTRY_ALLOW_CHOP turned on (CHOP was BankNifty's single largest regime bucket that day, 38% of bars, previously fully excluded). ENTRY_ML_MIN_PROB deliberately left at its original 0.6, NOT lowered alongside it -- reverted an initial 0.6->0.55 change same-day to isolate CHOP as the only variable; lowering the threshold inside a regime being reopened specifically for false-signal risk would have compounded, not just added to, that risk, and muddied which change did what. Revisit the threshold as its own decision once CHOP-alone has been observed. PRE_EXPIRY and STRATEGY_MIN_CONFIDENCE deliberately left untouched -- PRE_EXPIRY's risk is an unprotected gap (-16.3% in one bar, a different risk category than CHOP's 'market didn't move' losses), decided separately. 2026-08-20: DIRECTION_ML_MIN_MARGIN turned on at 0.05 -- BankNifty is the only instrument on ML-primary direction_ml mode (NIFTY/FINNIFTY/SENSEX all use the more conservative composite mode with their own margin gates); direction_dhan_bn_v3.joblib's holdout AUC is a weak 0.6165, and the margin gate had existed in code since 2026-07-19 but was left at its 0-disables-it default, so real historical direction calls included genuine near-coinflip commits (e.g. ce_prob=0.5194) with nothing to abstain them. Calibrated 0.05 against the real live probability distribution (21 historical direction_ml decisions: 2 fell below this margin, 19 above) -- filters the most degenerate near-toss-up cases without meaningfully cutting into real trade frequency, which was the whole reason CHOP got reopened in the first place. 2026-09-04: root-caused the Jul 20-23 buyer regression (dhan_entry_015pct_v1 was a known-weak model, holdout AUC 0.618, deployed despite explicit gate failures -- see .env.compose history). A same-methodology 15-min retrain on now-fully-clean data only reached AUC 0.636, confirming BankNifty's ceiling at this horizon isn't a data-pipeline artifact. A forgotten 2026-07-12 5-min-horizon rare-label approach scored much better (0.739 on stale data); retrained fresh it reaches holdout AUC 0.725, ship gates 3/4 pass (fails separation). Engine-level, capital-weighted backtest (Feb-Jul 2026, tier==live) showed only +0.52% return on capital vs the old model's +0.58% -- essentially flat, with worse tail risk -- so this is NOT a proven edge. Deployed anyway 2026-09-04 as a deliberate live trial per user instruction, to observe real trades before deciding whether to keep it, tune it further, or revert to dhan_entry_015pct_v1.joblib (untouched on disk, zero-file-change rollback). 2026-09-13: deployed this session's verified paper-only entry candidate (banknifty_entry_010pct_v1.joblib, thr=0.30, composite direction mode -- switches off direction_ml for this specific model swap; the direction_dhan_bn_v3.joblib decision documented above was for a different model and is not reversed by this). EXIT_GIVEBACK_MIN_MFE/PCT/TRAILING_* and EXIT_MAX_LOSS_PCT are now BankNifty-specific via BANKNIFTY_-namespaced overrides (see docker-compose.gcp.yml), no longer expected to match other instruments. operator_halt unaffected -- still paper-only.

option_trading-strategy_app_nifty-1._comment: 2026-08-10: calculated-risk loosening, same isolated pattern as BankNifty -- ENTRY_ALLOW_CHOP on (CHOP was ~20% of NIFTY's bars over a 3-day sample, previously fully excluded), ENTRY_ML_MIN_PROB left untouched to isolate the variable. Sourced from the namespaced NIFTY_ENTRY_ALLOW_CHOP in .env.compose, not the bare var BankNifty/historical/sim containers use. 2026-08-20: retrained on the fully-fixed historical data (schema-drift + IV-scale + ctx_gap fixes) -- v1 holdout AUC 0.6294/ship_gates none pass -> v2 holdout AUC 0.7327/ship_gates all pass. ENTRY_ML_MIN_PROB left untouched, same isolate-the-variable discipline. 2026-09-13: deployed this session's verified paper-only entry candidate (nifty_entry_010pct_v1.joblib, thr=0.50 unchanged, EXIT_MAX_LOSS_PCT=0.15 via NIFTY_EXIT_MAX_LOSS_PCT override -- opposite direction from BankNifty, confirmed instrument-specific by an isolated sweep). operator_halt unaffected -- still paper-only.

option_trading-strategy_app_sensex-1._comment: 2026-09-05: retrained on a fresh full re-backfill (Jan-Aug 2026, post ctx_gap_pct/iv_percentile fix) -- v2 holdout AUC 0.7051, ship_gates ALL_PASS (first SENSEX model to clear every gate, v1 failed auc>=0.70). Capital-weighted engine backtest (Feb-Aug 2026, real rupee P&L) confirmed it beats v1 in practice too: +Rs9,864/+2.02% return @thr=0.50 vs v1's +Rs4,590/+1.50% @thr=0.70 (v1's own threshold was picked for a different, since-superseded prob distribution). max_nan_features raised 2->3 to match v2's own training-time value; NOTE the capital-weighted backtest itself ran with no NaN gate at all (a methodology gap discovered post-backtest) so live behavior during the 09:15-09:45 warmup window should be watched for artifact trades before trusting this threshold long-term. User-approved deploy, still paper mode (EXECUTION_ADAPTER=paper) -- zero real-money exposure. v1 stays in repo unreferenced for rollback. 2026-09-13: deployed this session's verified paper-only entry candidate (sensex_entry_010pct_v1.joblib, thr=0.50 unchanged, default exit policy -- SENSEX's own sweep confirmed the default EXIT_MAX_LOSS_PCT=0.10 already sits at the optimal plateau). An operator_halt file was added for SENSEX specifically as part of this deploy -- unlike BankNifty/NIFTY, SENSEX had no halt gate before this and its buyer path had genuine real-execution capability (confirmed recent tier=live trades). Adding the halt keeps this rollout paper-only rather than silently changing real trading behavior. 2026-09-13: switched to budget_per_trade sizing (~50k notional/trade, RISK_MAX_LOTS_PER_TRADE raised 1->20 as a ceiling not a target) at user request to properly utilize allocated capital rather than hard-cap every trade at 1 lot.

option_trading-execution_app_nifty-1._comment: Added 2026-08-04: NIFTY's execution/seller containers had NO contract coverage at all (live money, zero drift detection) while BankNifty and FINNIFTY both did. Values pinned from the running container.

option_trading-strategy_app_midcpnifty-1._comment: 2026-09-13: MIDCPNIFTY's first-ever deployment of any kind -- no prior trading history existed for this instrument before this. Deployed this session's verified entry candidate (midcpnifty_entry_010pct_v1.joblib, thr=0.60, EXIT_MAX_LOSS_PCT=0.01 -- swept from default 0.10, MIDCPNIFTY wants a dramatically tighter stop than every other instrument). PAPER-ONLY via an operator_halt file created proactively before first launch -- the compose command's own '--rollout-stage paper' default does NOT actually gate real execution for the deterministic engine (verified in code: rollout_stage is only read by the retired ml_pure engine's runtime guard), so operator_halt is the real safety gate here, not the rollout flag's name. 2026-09-13: switched to budget_per_trade sizing (~50k notional/trade). This also fixes a real concentration risk: the old risk-based (stop-distance-driven) formula would have sized MIDCPNIFTY up to ~15 lots for the same risk budget that gives BankNifty only ~2, since MIDCPNIFTY's stop is the tightest of any instrument -- budget_per_trade sizes off premium x lot_size directly, independent of stop distance, avoiding that skew.
